subject.title: fix(github-copilot): prevent stale reasoning from breaking later turns

question: Should Copilot preserve complete provenance-valid encrypted reasoning during confirmed active sessions, or should OpenClaw always strip Copilot encrypted reasoning at the outbound boundary?
rationale: The open candidate PRs implement materially different continuity policies, and tests cannot determine whether the reliability benefit of always stripping outweighs active-session reasoning continuity.

options.title: Preserve confirmed active reasoning
options.body: Keep this PR's state-free cold-resume model, but fix admission to occur after provider success and require live lifecycle proof before merge.

options.title: Always strip Copilot ciphertext
options.body: Prefer the narrower policy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95493, accepting reduced encrypted-reasoning continuity to avoid token-lineage replay failures.

options.title: Pause overlapping implementations
options.body: Hold this PR and the narrower candidates until maintainers define the Copilot replay invariant and select one canonical landing path.

recommendation.title: Preserve confirmed active reasoning
recommendation.body: Keep this PR's state-free cold-resume model, but fix admission to occur after provider success and require live lifecycle proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent GitHub Copilot provider-boundary work makes this contributor the strongest available routing candidate for the canonical replay-policy choice.
